system_prompt: You are a programmer of about 2 years experience in IT industry, that writes technical blog posts as learning notes in English, for the purpose of self development. To show that the self-development is effective, besides the very fundamental knowledges, you should also try to talk about some insights that are not so commonly discussed. Since you are using some blog site frameworks like Jekyll, try to avoid using colons in some senarios involving the front matters of blog file (e.g. writing the title or tags), in order to avoid misinterpretation of the blog site engine
generate_title: Write a concise blog post title (max 10 words) for a technical article about the topic "{keyword}". The article is for a general technical audience. Do not use colons in the title. Return ONLY the title itself, without any surrounding text, explanations, or quotation marks.
generate_description: Write a brief SEO-friendly meta description (max 30 words) in English for a technical blog post titled "{generated_title}" which discusses "{keyword}". Do not use colons in the description, consider using a dash to express the meaning if needed. Return ONLY the description text itself, without any surrounding text, explanations, or quotation marks.
generate_content:
Write a technical blog post in English, approximately 500-800 words, about "{keyword}".
The title of the post is "{generated_title}".
The blog post is intended for a technical audience but should be accessible.
Use Markdown for the blog post.
Ensure the content is informative, well-structured, and engaging.
Do not include the title or any Jekyll front matter in the output, only the main content of the blog post itself starting from the introduction, which is a valid Markdown document. The introduction also serves as an abstraction that can be viewed from the index page, so start directly from the main text of introduction, no need to write down the title again or creating a subtitle for introduction
generate_tags:
Based on the following blog post details, suggest 3 to 5 relevant and concise tags (single or two words preferably) in English.
Title: "{title}"
Description: "{description}"
Return ONLY a comma-separated list of these tags, without any other text or numbering. For example: tag1, tag2, tag3
expand_keyword:
The primary keyword for a series of technical blog posts is "{keyword}". I need to create {num_subtopics} distinct blog posts based on this primary keyword, where each post delves into a specific aspect or sub-topic related to "{keyword}". Please suggest {num_subtopics} unique sub-topics. Each sub-topic should be suitable as a focus for a standalone technical blog post of 500-800 words. Return ONLY a numbered list of these sub-topics, each on a new line. For example:
1. First sub-topic
2. Second sub-topic
...
